disclaimerTitle: Draft contract — not yet legally reviewed

library.title: Contract library
library.description: Thai and English drafts from getproperty and the templates you adapted. Every draft is pending legal review.
library.mineHint: Copies you can edit. They are compared with the original draft and checked for forbidden clauses before publishing.
library.mineEmpty: No templates of your own yet
library.mineEmptyHint: Pick a draft from the library below and choose "Copy to edit".
library.platformHint: Drafts prepared by getproperty. They cannot be edited here — copy one to your templates first.

copy.label: Copy to edit
copy.title: Copy {name}
copy.body: The copy becomes a draft of yours. You can edit its text; it stays pending legal review like the original.
copy.name: Template name
copy.nameHint: Leave empty to name it after the original

editor.platformBody: Copy it to your templates to edit the text; it will be compared with this draft and checked for forbidden clauses.
editor.textHint: Each clause is a section element with an h2 heading. Only basic HTML and the listed variables are allowed.
editor.name: Template name
editor.bodyHint: Scripts, styles, links and triple braces are refused when you save.
editor.nextDraft: This template is published; saving opens draft version {version}.
editor.publishBody: {version} can be used for contracts right away and stays marked as pending legal review until counsel signs it off. A clause forbidden by the OCPB announcement prevents publishing.
editor.saveFirst: Save the draft before checking or publishing.
editor.nothingToPublish: No draft is waiting to be published. Edit and save to open a new version.
editor.variablesHint: Click to insert at the cursor. Values are filled from the unit, the lease and the parties.
editor.unknownBody: A text with these variables will be refused.
editor.previewHint: The text as typed, with variables highlighted. The PDF uses the last saved draft filled with sample values.
editor.diffSaved: Compared from the last saved draft — save to see your latest edits.
editor.diffUnavailable: The comparison could not be loaded. Try again.
editor.diffNoBase: This template has no original to compare with.
editor.checkHint: Checks the last saved draft against the OCPB announcement on forbidden clauses.
editor.checkReadOnly: Clause checks are available on your own templates.
editor.checkNote: The check points out clauses to fix; it is not legal approval.

compliance.inScopeTitle: Within the OCPB announcement (3 or more units let)
compliance.inScopeBody: A forbidden clause prevents publishing until it is fixed.
compliance.outOfScopeBody: Findings are warnings with their legal reason. You can publish, but should fix them first.
compliance.cleanBody: This draft is still pending review by counsel.
compliance.notPublishable: Cannot be published yet — fix the findings above

documents.title: Other contracts
documents.description: Reservations, lease addenda, brokerage mandates and co-broke agreements — signed online and kept as evidence.
documents.emptyHint: Create a reservation or an addendum with "New contract".

create.label: New contract
create.title: Create a contract
create.body: Type only what is asked; the unit, lease and party details are filled in for you. The draft stays pending legal review.
create.templateHint: One of your published templates, or the library draft
create.titleHint: Leave empty to use the template name and unit
create.rentHint: Leave empty to use the unit's rent
create.refundHint: Refund and forfeiture wording is still awaiting counsel's review
create.noteHint: Commission is paid directly between the parties, outside getproperty

detail.signersHint: Residents and prospects sign in the LINE app with an OTP; your team signs here with a drawn signature.
detail.evidence: Every signature is recorded with its time, channel and the file checksum; the signed file is kept as evidence that cannot be deleted.
detail.valuesHint: Everything else in the contract comes from the unit, the lease and the parties.

actions.sendBody: A number is issued, the PDF of "{title}" is generated and every signer is notified. The text cannot be changed afterwards.
actions.signBody: Read the PDF in full before signing; your signature is bound to this file's checksum.
actions.cancelBody: The remaining signers can no longer sign. Files already issued are kept as evidence.
actions.documentFailed: The contract file could not be opened. Close this window and try again.

renewals.title: Renewals
renewals.description: Renewal offers sent to residents and their answers from the LINE app.
renewals.howTo: Offer a renewal from the lease page; the renewal offer letter is sent to the resident at the same time.
renewals.emptyHint: You are reminded 60 and 30 days before a lease ends.
renewals.offerBody: The renewal offer letter goes to the resident at once. They accept or decline in the LINE app; on acceptance the renewal lease is drafted and sent for signature.
renewals.noSuggestion: No suggestion yet — enter the rent you want to offer.
renewals.messageHint: Optional; shown in the letter and in LINE
renewals.withdrawTitle: Withdraw the renewal offer for unit {unitNo}?
renewals.withdrawBody: The resident can no longer accept this offer. The letter already sent stays in the history.
renewals.leaseHint: Offer a renewal with the suggested rent, or write an addendum to this lease.
